text: なぜ……　なぜ　まけてしまったんだ……　おれの　そだてかた……　まちがってなんか　いないはずなのに　しょうが　ないぜ……　おまえが　ポケモン　リーグ　しん　チャンピオンだ……！

structure.jp: なぜ……　なぜ　まけてしまったんだ……
structure.en: why... why did I go and lose...

structure.jp: おれの　そだてかた……
まちがってなんか　いないはずなのに
structure.en: even though it surely isn't wrong at all

structure.jp: おまえが　ポケモン　リーグ　しん　チャンピオンだ……！
structure.en: you are the new Pokémon League Champion...!

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happened completely, to your regret. まけてしまった = 'I went and lost'.

patterns.name: 〜はずだ
patterns.explanation: はず says something ought to be so, as far as you can tell. まちがってなんか　いないはず = 'it surely isn't wrong'.

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに means 'even though', with frustration that things went the other way; after はず it needs な in between. いないはずなのに = 'even though it shouldn't be (wrong)'.
